digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 20 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 11 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.summary_zh: 面向 AI 编码 Agent 的生产级工程技能库，直接来自资深工程师的实战配置，让 AI 更像成熟开发者

repos.name: openai/codex
repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: 终端里跑的轻量级 Rust 编码 Agent，用自然语言直接操控代码库，极速响应且不依赖云端

repos.name: earendil-works/pi
repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.summary_zh: 统一大模型API、内置Agent循环与TUI终端，让AI编码助手和命令行工具开发一步到位

repos.name: ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills
repos.description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
repos.summary_zh: 精选 Claude 技能与工具资源库，帮你快速定制 AI 工作流，提升自动化效率

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx
repos.description: A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents
repos.summary_zh: 自建无纸化文档管理利器，扫描后自动OCR识别、分类归档，让纸质文件秒变可搜索数字库

repos.name: DioxusLabs/dioxus
repos.description: Fullstack app framework for web, desktop, and mobile.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的一个框架，让你用一套代码同时搞定 Web、桌面和移动端的全栈应用开发

repos.name: rustfs/rustfs
repos.description: 🚀2.3x faster than MinIO for 4KB object payloads. RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration a
repos.summary_zh: 开源 S3 兼容对象存储，4KB 小对象性能比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍，支持无缝迁移与共存

repos.name: RyanCodrai/turbovec
repos.description: A vector index built on TurboQuant, written in Rust with Python bindings
repos.summary_zh: 基于 TurboQuant 的高性能向量索引，Rust 实现并绑定 Python，兼顾极致速度与易用性

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: jmerelnyc/Talos
repos.description: GPU worker client for the Talos network. Pairs with your Talos account, serves open-model inference jobs over a WebSocket, and reports uptime for payo
repos.summary_zh: 为 Talos 网络贡献 GPU 跑开源模型推理，通过 WebSocket 接任务并上报在线时长赚取收益

repos.name: xiaol/wkvm
repos.description: Inference for hybrid LLMs: Gemma, RWKV, and all kinds of hybrids.
repos.summary_zh: 混合LLM推理引擎，专为Gemma、RWKV等异构模型设计，解决混合架构部署难题

repos.name: drumih/turbo-fieldfare
repos.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook
repos.summary_zh: 在 2GB 内存的 M 系列 MacBook 上运行 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 推理，让大模型在低配苹果设备上也能流畅跑

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: MoonshotAI/PerceptionBench
repos.description: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
repos.summary_zh: 多模态大模型视觉感知能力的原子级评测基准，精准定位模型在细节识别与空间关系上的真实短板

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: koala73/worldmonitor
repos.description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard. AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking in a unified situational aw
repos.summary_zh: 实时全球情报聚合仪表盘，用AI整合新闻、地缘政治与基础设施数据，打造统一态势感知界面

repos.name: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
repos.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.summary_zh: 从零构建完整AI工程体系，涵盖生产级代码与部署实践，适合想系统掌握AI工程化能力的开发者

repos.name: cjpais/Handy
repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: 完全离线的免费开源语音转文字工具，用 Rust 打造，隐私安全且支持扩展

repos.name: Effect-TS/effect
repos.description: Build production-ready applications in TypeScript
repos.summary_zh: TypeScript 原生函数式编程框架，用类型安全的方式解决复杂异步与错误处理难题，让代码更健壮可维护

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: ruvnet/RuView
repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel
repos.summary_zh: 用普通WiFi信号实现无摄像头实时空间感知、生命体征监测与存在检测，隐私保护下的智能传感革命

repos.name: dani-garcia/vaultwarden
repos.description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写的轻量级 Bitwarden 兼容服务端，资源占用极低且可自托管，适合不想依赖官方云的用户

repos.name: jamiepine/voicebox
repos.description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI语音工作室，支持声音克隆、语音转写与生成，让零门槛创建专属语音成为现实

repos.name: vnpy/vnpy
repos.description: 基于Python的开源量化交易平台开发框架
repos.summary_zh: 全功能开源量化交易框架，覆盖CTA、套利、期权等策略，支持对接国内主流柜台与数据源

papers.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default
papers.summary_zh: 重新审视策略扩散蒸馏中的无分类器引导机制 发现现有方法在引导强度与蒸馏损失间存在根本冲突 提出自适应引导调度策略 在保持生成质量的同时将蒸馏步数减少至4步 性能超越8步基线

papers.title: Efficient LLM-Generated Shuttling Compilers for Complex Trapped-Ion Architectures
papers.abstract: Trapped-ion quantum computers rely on shuttling compilers, which cast an input algorithm into a sequence of ion-qubit movements within a given architecture. We present the first study in which a singl
papers.summary_zh: 首次利用单一前沿大语言模型Claude Opus 4.7自动生成并迭代优化离子阱量子计算穿梭编译器，在复杂架构上实现编译效率与算法保真度的显著提升

papers.title: Denial of Deadline: Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse in Distributed Inference Pipelines
papers.abstract: Inference systems increasingly combine a fast path that returns predictions within the application's latency deadline together with a higher-accuracy slow path that runs higher-compute methods on stro
papers.summary_zh: 揭示分布式推理中网络延迟导致慢路径结果超时失效的机制，提出网络驱动精度崩溃现象，实验显示网络延迟增加10%可使系统准确率下降超50%

papers.title: A corrective agentic hybrid RAG and an operations-grounded evaluation for a scientific facility
papers.abstract: Scientific user facilities accumulate decades of operational knowledge that no single search index covers: electronic logbooks, technical documents, internal wikis, operations chat messages, maintenan
papers.summary_zh: 提出混合纠错型RAG框架融合多源异构数据，在科学设施运维问答中准确率提升22%，并构建操作日志驱动的评估基准

papers.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
papers.abstract: Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear. Existing models are trained on uncontrollable and opaque Internet data, m
papers.summary_zh: 提出单教师与多教师在线策略蒸馏框架，揭示多轮长程规划能力从预训练到后训练的获取机制，在复杂任务上规划成功率提升超20%

papers.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) hold immense potential to revolutionize clinical practice, yet deploying them in the medical domain is fundamentally a vision-centric challenge: models must ab
papers.summary_zh: 提出以视觉为中心的多模态大模型ClinFusion，统一处理2D与3D医学影像，在多项临床任务上超越现有方法并实现高效推理

papers.title: KANEx: Translating Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks' Interpretability to Medical Explainability
papers.abstract: Computer vision models have become highly effective for medical applications, yet their black-box nature continues to undermine clinician trust. In clinical workflows, chest X-ray classifiers are incr
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于KAN网络的可解释性翻译框架，在胸部X光分类任务上实现95%准确率，同时生成临床可理解的病理定位解释，显著提升医生信任度

papers.title: ERUnderstand: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Structured ER Diagrams
papers.abstract: Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERDs) are central to conceptual database design, yet they are typically available only as rendered images rather than machine-readable schemas, limiting AI-assisted datab
papers.summary_zh: 提出首个结构化ER图理解基准ERUnderstand，评估视觉语言模型在数据库设计任务中的表现，发现现有模型准确率不足40%

papers.title: Certified Parallel-in-Time Sinkhorn for Dynamic Entropic Optimal Transport
papers.abstract: Dynamic applications, including optimal-transport Flow Matching, repeatedly solve related entropic optimal transport problems, yet conventional distributed Sinkhorn processes frames sequentially and s
papers.summary_zh: 提出时序并行Sinkhorn算法，将动态熵最优传输的帧间迭代解耦为独立子问题，实现线性加速比并消除同步瓶颈

papers.title: Learning Distributions from Multiple Data Providers
papers.abstract: Motivated by learning from heterogeneous and overlapping data providers, we study a stylized model of distribution learning from restricted conditional samples. The goal is to learn an unknown distrib
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于受限条件样本的多数据源分布学习框架，在有限域上实现样本复杂度与查询集结构匹配的近似最优估计

papers.title: Global Convergence of DGM and PINN Algorithms for Solving Nonlinear PDEs
papers.abstract: The Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) and Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have become widely-used methods for solving partial differential equations (PDEs) in the rapidly growing field of scientific
papers.summary_zh: 首次证明DGM与PINN算法在求解非线性PDE时全局收敛，给出收敛率与网络宽度深度显式依赖关系
